tldr: The chorus found one real hole in spec 017: in a per-project install the retuned file and the installer's own file sit at the same path, so a re-run with --force silently erases the retune (F32, escalated to 🔴; the claim that the installer never reaches the copy was dropped after its own author corrected it).

Staleness is the other cluster: a copy never learns the plugin moved (F12, F16 escalated to 🔴). The cheapest zero-code fix is to stamp the shipped version in the reason comment, name the symptom, and give one diff command.

Three 🔴 findings block calling the spec ready: F32 (the --force erase), F16 (no shipped-version stamp in a copy) and F12 (silent staleness with no named symptom). Docs-only is the right size at no maintainer capacity (F36), but the README must stay short (R2-32); two conflicts are left for the operator: whether to record an ADR, and how many sentences the README section may hold.
